MemberSignature.Value: .field public static literal valuetype Android.App.Admin.SecurityLogTags OsStartup = int32(210009)
OsStartup = 210009

Docs.summary: The Android OS started. The event records the result of the software integrity check at startup. contains these items: [0] the Verified Boot state (string): green, yellow, or orange; [1] the dm-verity mode (string): enforcing, eio, or disabled. The green state shows a full chain of trust from the bootloader to all verified partitions. The yellow state shows that the boot partition was verified with the embedded certificate. The orange state shows that the device can be freely modified. In enforcing mode, the device restarts when it finds corruption. In eio mode, a read of corrupted data blocks returns an I/O error. In disabled mode, the integrity check is off.
